amplitude_meaning: Gaussian peak amplitude in a synthetic demonstration image. Not an AB magnitude and not a calibrated flux.
notes: Hand-built synthetic demonstration catalogues for the RomanRecoverer software test. These are not NGRST-Discovery-Toolkit outputs and not Roman observations. Columns follow the toolkit contract: truth x,y,amplitude,sigma,class and detections x_centroid,y_centroid,snr,anomaly_score. t08 has no detection. d08 and d09 match no injection.
